release_notes: Upgraded Generate + Schedule to Generate + Autopilot: new quiz batches keep running through tracking creation, website preparation, and the batch promo-scheduling step after the full videos are scheduled.
Logo and other visual-question media are now copied into each newly generated quiz project before promo creation, so logo quiz promo Shorts keep the actual logo artwork instead of becoming text-only.
Autopilot keeps the remaining manual work focused on platform limitations such as Instagram publishing and YouTube Shorts Related video setup.
Added website support for visual quiz questions: accessible logo/question images are resized safely and synced to Cloudflare, then shown above the website question without exposing the answer.
Prepare website now refreshes existing staged quiz copies as well as new ones, so website media improvements can be applied without deleting or duplicating quizzes.
